links.outcome: Currency and accuracy of ChatGPT clinical knowledge on shoulder arthroplasty questions, graded by surgeons
links.effect: Overall grade B-; the chatbot neglected recent research, resulting in recommendations that warrant professional clarification; errors when supplementing its own responses.
links.quote: However, the chatbot neglected recent research in its responses, resulting in recommendations that warrant professional clarification.

links.outcome: Whether ChatGPT deferred specific questions to orthopedic surgeons
links.effect: Deferred to orthopedic surgeons in 8 of 15 questions; also often went beyond the scope of the question after the first 2 sentences.
links.quote: The interface deferred specific questions to orthopedic surgeons in 8 of 15 questions, suggesting its awareness of its own limitations.

screen.reason: The study evaluates the baseline accuracy and quality of ChatGPT in answering common patient questions regarding total shoulder arthroplasty without testing any deployment safeguard or organizational practice.
